sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive and value-oriented sectors are showing robust underlying breadth, while high-momentum technology begins to slip in ranking despite its strong nominal score.

Defensive and rate-sensitive sectors are asserting their dominance as Healthcare, Real Estate, Financials, and Consumer Defensive emerge as the four "all-green" groups, showing positive performance across all timeframes from one week to year-to-date. Healthcare is leading this charge with a top-tier momentum score of 0.72, while Consumer Defensive and Energy have made the largest weekly rank advancements, each climbing 2 spots. 

Conversely, cyclical and growth sectors are showing signs of exhaustion. Technology has slipped 1 spot in rank over the last 5 sessions, signaling a potential cooling off despite its high momentum. The deepest weekly decline belongs to Basic Materials, which tumbled 3 spots to rank 8th, while Consumer Cyclical remains anchored to the bottom of the board as the market's primary laggard.

## Strength
* **Broad-Based Defensives:** Four out of 11 market groups are "all-green" across all timeframes: Healthcare (0.72 momentum), Real Estate (0.53 momentum), Financials (0.50 momentum), and Consumer Defensive (0.48 momentum).
* **Healthcare Leading:** Healthcare holds the highest momentum score in the market at 0.72, combining perfect cross-timeframe breadth with strong performance.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top Weekly Gainers:** Consumer Defensive (up 2 spots to rank 5), Energy (up 2 spots to rank 1), and Healthcare (up 2 spots to rank 6) showed the strongest short-term rank improvements.
* **Momentum Leaders:** Healthcare (0.72), Technology (0.67), and Energy (0.65) lead the market in absolute momentum scores.
* **Deepest Decliners:** Basic Materials fell 3 spots to rank 8 with a weak 0.25 momentum score, while Consumer Cyclical remains the absolute laggard at rank 11 with a momentum score of just 0.18.

## Divergences
* **Technology Fading:** Despite holding the second-highest momentum score of 0.67, Technology's rank slipped by 1 spot over the last 5 sessions, indicating early-stage exhaustion.
* **Fragile Financials:** While Financials achieved "all-green" status, the sector displays a highly fragile agreement score of just 0.20, alongside a 1-spot weekly rank decline to rank 10.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive healthcare and financial conglomerates lead a narrow market advance, while housing, solar, and industrial momentum begins to unravel.

Market breadth remains highly concentrated, with only 30 of 144 industry groups maintaining "all-green" status across all time horizons. Defensive healthcare sectors—specifically REIT - Healthcare Facilities, Healthcare Plans, and Biotechnology—are showing exceptional sustained strength alongside Financial Conglomerates and Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing.

Conversely, housing and cyclical industries are rotating downward rapidly. Solar, Lumber & Wood Production, and Residential Construction have suffered severe rank declines over the last five sessions, while momentum laggards like Pharmaceutical Retailers and Independent Power Producers remain pinned to the bottom of the market. 

## Strength
* **All-Green Leaders:** Financial Conglomerates (0.88 momentum) and Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (0.87 momentum) lead the 30 groups holding positive performance across weekly, monthly, quarterly, half-year, and YTD frames.
* **Defensive Healthcare Dominance:** REIT - Healthcare Facilities (0.87 momentum), Healthcare Plans (0.87 momentum), and Biotechnology (0.85 momentum) are demonstrating sustained leadership, ranking in the top 36 across 1-, 3-, and 6-month periods.
* **Secondary All-Green Pockets:** Food Distribution (0.78 momentum), Insurance - Reinsurance (0.77 momentum), and Consumer Electronics (0.76 momentum) also maintain perfect green profiles.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Rapid Climbers:** Staffing & Employment Services surged +32 spots to rank 41 (0.74 momentum), followed closely by Education & Training Services (+28 spots to rank 63) and Internet Content & Information (+22 spots to rank 61).
* **Sharpest Decliners:** Solar plummeted -28 spots to rank 106 (0.30 momentum), while Lumber & Wood Production (-27 spots to rank 76) and Residential Construction (-26 spots to rank 90) experienced heavy selling.
* **Absolute Laggards:** Pharmaceutical Retailers (0.119 momentum, YTD rank 144) and Airports & Air Services (0.156 momentum, YTD rank 132) remain the weakest links in the market.

## Divergences
* **Fading Momentum:** Airlines (0.65 momentum) dropped -23 spots, and Specialty Industrial Machinery (0.61 momentum) fell -15 spots, signaling that high-momentum groups are starting to slip.
* **Emerging Turnarounds:** Financial Data & Stock Exchanges jumped +16 spots despite low momentum (0.36), while Grocery Stores climbed +14 spots with a momentum score of 0.31, indicating early-stage accumulation.
* **Fragile All-Green Groups:** Medical Care Facilities (0.41 agreement) and Medical Distribution (0.46 agreement) are exhibiting low trend agreement, making their all-green status highly unstable.
